description.value: Alty Conservancy is a provincially protected nature conservancy managed by BC Parks, situated in the remote North Coast and Haida Gwaii region of British Columbia. As a conservancy designation, it balances conservation of natural and cultural heritage with low-impact recreation. Touring cyclists venturing into this remote coastal wilderness would encounter an undeveloped wild landscape typical of BC's northwest coast.

The management plans page confirms Alty Conservancy exists as a real protected area under active BC Parks management ('K'waal Conservancy and Alty Conservancy' listed under management plans in development). No amenity evidence is available for any required or optional criteria; all must be null. The OSM record contains only the name, coordinates, and website URL, with no address, phone, or other contact details to cross-check.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Alty Conservancy is a real, publicly accessible BC Parks protected area confirmed active under provincial management. Remote wilderness attractions are useful waypoints for touring cyclists exploring the North Coast region.
